heading: Choose the setting first
intro: Picture the experience you want before choosing a departure. A road-access base, a river-transfer lodge and a reserve program can use your time differently. Read the destination guides, then ask the provider how its exact location supports your interests. Keep the complete journey from Quito in the comparison, even when the package begins elsewhere.
points: Which destination and exact property location appear in the proposal, and which outings take place nearby?
How much of your available time is spent reaching the base rather than taking part in activities?
If comparing Yasuní/Napo properties, which are inside the national park and which are elsewhere in the corridor?

heading: Identify the actual pickup
intro: Transport included needs a precise starting point. Ask whether the booking covers your departure from Quito or begins at a regional meeting place. Confirm the address, contact person and agreed arrival arrangements. If you organize the earlier journey yourself, check how it connects with the included services and what happens if you arrive late.
points: Where do the included services begin, and is getting to that meeting point your responsibility?
Who confirms the meeting arrangements and whom should you contact if your arrival plans change?
Does the proposal identify any accommodation needed before the package starts or after it ends?

heading: Map every transfer segment
intro: Ask for a single journey outline from your starting point to the accommodation and back to your final destination. Mark each included segment and each separate booking. Compare shared and private arrangements, luggage handling and meeting points. A clear route helps you understand the effort involved without assuming a particular flight, vehicle or boat service exists.
points: Which road, river or other transport segments are included, and which need a separate reservation or payment?
What luggage limits and handling arrangements apply to the services the provider has actually confirmed?
How do the transfer times affect meals, rest and the activities offered on arrival and departure days?

heading: Plan the onward connection
intro: Work backward from your next fixed commitment, whether it is a flight, accommodation check-in or another tour. Ask the provider to explain the return route and how changes are handled. Discuss the time needed between services and any separate overnight stay. Keep the contact details and written terms together so you know who is responsible for each part.
points: Does the complete return journey fit your onward plans according to the provider’s current arrangements?
What happens if a transfer is delayed, and which services fall outside the package operator’s responsibility?
Would a separate overnight stay give your journey a pace that better matches your priorities?

heading: Match guiding to your group
intro: Guiding shapes how you experience the forest. Describe your interests, preferred language, walking pace and group requirements before accepting a program. Ask about the actual group size and whether outings are shared or private. Compare the guide’s relevant experience with the activities you want, while remembering that knowledge and time outdoors do not guarantee particular sightings.
points: What relevant experience does the guide have, and can the activities be explained in your preferred language?
How many travelers join each outing, and which parts of the itinerary are shared with other groups?
What adjustments can the provider confirm for your walking pace, family needs or particular interests?

heading: Keep one complete proposal
intro: Bring the route, accommodation and activities into one written proposal before making a decision. Compare the same dates, group and starting point across options. Identify the operator, payment recipient, inclusions, exclusions and change terms. Written answers give you a record to review; they still need to be checked for completeness and consistency with your plans.
points: Are accommodation nights, meals, guiding, equipment and applicable fees clearly listed for the agreed itinerary?
Who operates the stay and receives payment, and what change or cancellation terms apply to your booking?
Does the final proposal answer your original priorities without relying on vague inclusions or promised wildlife sightings?
